_comment: Tracked recurring issues found by the weekly calibration agent. Each issue has: id, theme (or category, or null for global), first_observed (run_id), last_observed (run_id), status (open|monitoring|resolved), description, evidence_runs (list of run_ids), actions_taken (list of {run_date, action}), recommendation_pending (bool, true if the fix requires a human edit to a forbidden/prompt-level field).

issues.description: RESOLVED: The catastrophic weekday theme score collapse that persisted from July 26 through August 10 (16 consecutive runs) was fixed by the August 11 rearchitecture introducing dimensional scoring (quality/relevance/local) and relative scaling for podcast theme scores. Post-August 11 runs show healthy mean_theme_score_raw values across all themes: Monday 15.2–33.4 (vs collapsed 3.2–8.2 pre-fix), Tuesday 4.4–13.3 (vs dead 3.1), Wednesday 2.7–10.8 (vs weak 9.1), Thursday 7.0–23.1 (vs dead 4.7). Podcast feeds consistently hit target 100 articles with robust holdover banks (2466–2931 per theme). The composite histograms post-August 11 show normal distributions rather than 0-19 concentration. The relative_scaled flag confirms new scoring is active. Marking resolved after 13 consecutive healthy runs (August 11–30) with no sign of regression.
